fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: The passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date of arrival.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de emisión de menos de 10 años antes de la llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At border control you may need to show proof of your accommodation, such as a hotel booking confirmation.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo puede que debas mostrar prueba de alojamiento, como una confirmación de reserva de hotel.
entry.quote: show proof of your accommodation, for example, a hotel booking confirmation or proof of address for a second home

entry.en: At border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo puede que debas mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje de 10.000 euros o más deben declararse.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into Monaco, with some exceptions.
entry.es: No se puede llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a Mónaco, con algunas excepciones.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into Monaco.

safety.en: Street crime is rare, but sensible precautions to protect your passport and valuables are advised.
safety.es: El delito callejero es raro, pero se aconsejan precauciones sensatas para proteger el pasaporte y los objetos de valor.
safety.quote: Street crime is rare, but take sensible precautions to protect your passport and valuables.

safety.en: Thefts have happened on trains to and from Monaco and at Nice airport car rental parks, where bags were stolen while drivers loaded their cars.
safety.es: Se han producido robos en trenes de y hacia Mónaco y en los aparcamientos de alquiler de coches del aeropuerto de Niza.
safety.quote: Thefts have happened on trains to and from Monaco, and at Nice airport, particularly at the car rental parks where bags have been stolen while drivers are loading their cars.

safety.en: There is no recent history of terrorism in Monaco, but attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No hay historial reciente de terrorismo en Mónaco, pero no se pueden descartar atentados.
safety.quote: Although there’s no recent history of terrorism in Monaco, attacks cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Pickpocketing may occur during sporting events such as the Formula One Grand Prix and major football games.
safety.es: Puede haber carterismo durante eventos deportivos como el Gran Premio de Fórmula 1 y partidos de fútbol importantes.
safety.quote: However, pickpocketing may occur during sporting events, like the Formula One Grand Prix and major football games.

safety.en: Get local advice before swimming in the sea, especially if you see jellyfish.
safety.es: Pide consejo local antes de nadar en el mar, sobre todo si ves medusas.
safety.quote: Get local advice before swimming in the sea, especially if you see jellyfish.

health.en: To call an ambulance, dial 112 from a mobile or 18 from a landline.
health.es: Para llamar a una ambulancia, marca el 112 desde un móvil o el 18 desde un fijo.
health.quote: Call 112 from a mobile or 18 from a landline and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Monaco is not an EU member, so reciprocal EU medical arrangements do not apply.
health.es: Mónaco no es miembro de la UE, por lo que no se aplican los acuerdos médicos recíprocos de la UE.
health.quote: Monaco is not a member of the EU so reciprocal medical arrangements with the EU do not apply.

health.en: The EHIC and UK GHIC health cards are not accepted in Monaco.
health.es: Las tarjetas sanitarias EHIC y GHIC del Reino Unido no se aceptan en Mónaco.
health.quote: The European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) or UK Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) are not accepted in Monaco.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink.

help.en: The emergency number is 112 on a mobile or 18 on a landline for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 112 desde móvil o el 18 desde fijo para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.
help.quote: Telephone: 112 on a mobile or 18 on a landline (ambulance, fire, police)

getting_in.en: The nearest airport is Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE), around 40 km from the city centre.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto más cercano es Niza Costa Azul (NCE), a unos 40 km del centro.
getting_in.quote: The nearest airport is at Nice,  1 Aéroport Nice Côte d'Azur  (NCE IATA) in Alpes-Maritimes, which is around 40 km (25 mi) away from the city centre.

getting_in.en: From the airport you can take a tram to Grand Arénas and change to the train to Monaco for about €6 (Mar 2024).
getting_in.es: Desde el aeropuerto puedes tomar un tranvía a Grand Arénas y cambiar al tren a Mónaco por unos 6 € (marzo de 2024).
getting_in.quote: You can take a tram from the airport to Grand Arénas and change there to the train to Monaco for about €6 (Mar 2024).

getting_in.en: Express shuttle route 80 links Nice airport and Menton with stops near all major hotels in Monaco.
getting_in.es: El autobús exprés 80 une el aeropuerto de Niza y Menton con paradas cerca de los principales hoteles de Mónaco.
getting_in.quote: An express shuttle, route 80, links the Nice Côte d'Azur Airport and Menton with multiple stops near all major hotels throughout Monaco, not just the ward of Monte Carlo.

getting_in.en: The train to Monaco runs along the coast from Cannes in France to Ventimiglia in Italy.
getting_in.es: El tren a Mónaco recorre la costa desde Cannes, en Francia, hasta Ventimiglia, en Italia.
getting_in.quote: The train stopping in Monaco operates along the coast from Cannes in France to Ventimiglia in Italy.

getting_in.en: Regional buses 600 and 602 connect Monaco with Nice.
getting_in.es: Los autobuses regionales 600 y 602 conectan Mónaco con Niza.
getting_in.quote: Regional buses 600 (along the coast, every 15 min) and 602 (over Eze Village, every 2 hours) connect Monaco with Nice

getting_in.en: Monaco is not part of the Schengen Area but has open borders with France.
getting_in.es: Mónaco no forma parte del espacio Schengen pero tiene fronteras abiertas con Francia.
getting_in.quote: Although Monaco is not part of the Schengen Area, it has open borders with France, so it can for all practical purposes be considered part of it.

getting_around.en: There are seven free public escalators and elevators that help with the steep slopes of the city.
getting_around.es: Hay siete escaleras mecánicas y ascensores públicos gratuitos que ayudan con las empinadas cuestas de la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: There are also seven public escalators and elevators (all free) that help negotiate the steep slopes of the city.

getting_around.en: The urban bus service has five routes (1, 2, 4, 5 and 6) serving 143 stops.
getting_around.es: El servicio de autobús urbano tiene cinco líneas (1, 2, 4, 5 y 6) con 143 paradas.
getting_around.quote: Monaco has an urban bus service, operated by the Compagnie des Autobus Monaco, through the city's five bus routes (labelled 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6) which serves 143 stops.

getting_around.en: Bus tickets cost €2 on board or €1.50 from ticket machines at the stops.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de autobús cuestan 2 € a bordo o 1,50 € en las máquinas de las paradas.
getting_around.quote: Tickets can be purchased on board the buses (€2) or at many news vendors and shops throughout the city and at auto ticket machines at the bus stops (€1.50)

getting_around.en: The Bateau Bus is a pedestrian-only ferry across Port Hercule that runs about every 20 minutes in daylight and costs €2.
getting_around.es: El Bateau Bus es un ferri peatonal que cruza el Puerto Hércules cada 20 minutos aproximadamente de día y cuesta 2 €.
getting_around.quote: look for the small 9 Bateau Bus, a pedestrian-only ferry that runs each 20 minutes or so during daylight; it costs €2.

getting_around.en: Taxis cannot be hailed on the street; there are two main taxi stands open around the clock.
getting_around.es: No se pueden parar taxis en la calle; hay dos paradas principales abiertas las 24 horas.
getting_around.quote: Taxis cannot be hailed on the streets (they won't stop) and there are two main taxi stands open around the clock at the Avenue de Monte Carlo and the railway station

getting_around.en: Uber, Bolt and other ride sharing apps are banned in Monaco.
getting_around.es: Uber, Bolt y otras apps de viajes compartidos están prohibidas en Mónaco.
getting_around.quote: Uber, Bolt and other ride sharing apps are banned in Monaco.

money.quote: Like its neighbour, France, Monaco uses the euro.

money.en: Currency exchange is readily available for a wide range of currencies and ATMs are commonplace.
money.es: El cambio de divisas está ampliamente disponible para muchas monedas y los cajeros son habituales.
money.quote: Currency exchange is readily available for a wide range of currencies. ATMs are commonplace.

money.en: Normal shopping hours are 09:00 to 12:00 and 15:00 to 19:00.
money.es: El horario normal de compras es de 09:00 a 12:00 y de 15:00 a 19:00.
money.quote: The normal shopping hours are from 09:00 to 12:00 and 15:00 to 19:00.

money.en: Shopping in Monte Carlo is described as quite exclusive and no place for a budget holiday.
money.es: Se describe las compras en Montecarlo como bastante exclusivas y nada aptas para unas vacaciones económicas.
money.quote: Shopping in Monte Carlo is usually quite exclusive and is certainly no place for a budget holiday.

etiquette.en: Monaco is a separate nation and it may be insulting to casually conflate it with France.
etiquette.es: Mónaco es una nación aparte y puede resultar insultante confundirla alegremente con Francia.
etiquette.quote: Monaco is a separate nation and it may be insulting to casually conflate the two.

etiquette.en: You could be fined for walking around in swimsuits, stripped to the waist or barefoot, except on beaches and bathing areas.
etiquette.es: Podrías recibir una multa por pasear en traje de baño, sin camiseta o descalzo, salvo en playas y zonas de baño.
etiquette.quote: You could get a fine if you walk around in swimsuits, stripped to the waist, or barefoot, apart from on beaches and in bathing areas.

connectivity.en: Monaco Telecom, the local operator, is not covered by EU roaming rules.
connectivity.es: Monaco Telecom, el operador local, no está cubierto por las normas de itinerancia de la UE.
connectivity.quote: Monaco has its own mobile phone operator, Monaco Telecom, which is not covered by EU roaming rules.

connectivity.en: SIM cards registered in an EU country, including France, may incur roaming charges in Monaco.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM registradas en un país de la UE, incluida Francia, pueden generar cargos de itinerancia en Mónaco.
connectivity.quote: mobile numbers and SIM cards registered in an EU country, including France, may incur roaming charges

connectivity.en: Without the local Monaco Telecom or French Orange, internet is extremely slow or even non-functional.
connectivity.es: Sin Monaco Telecom local u Orange francés, el internet es muy lento o incluso no funciona.
connectivity.quote: if you don't use the local Monaco Telecom or French Orange, internet is extremely slow or even non-functional.
